shapeSummary: A single 20 mm diameter, 6 mm tall aluminum hub disc with its axis along Y and its bottom at Y=0. It has a 3 mm central through bore, four 3 mm blind mounting holes 4 mm deep from the top face at (±5, ±5) in XZ, and one 3 mm radial set-screw hole on the +Z rim at mid-height that runs into the bore. The set screws and Allen wrench are not modeled.
warnings: Only the 3 mm shaft diameter is given. The 20 mm outer diameter and 6 mm thickness are estimated from the photo.
The bolt circle (about 7.07 mm radius, holes at 45°) and the 3 mm mounting-hole diameter are estimates. The real holes are M3 threaded, and threads are not modeled.
The depth of the mounting holes is unknown, so I used a 4 mm blind depth. They may be through holes.
The set-screw hole diameter and its direction around the rim (+Z here) are assumed.
Only one hub is modeled. The second hub, the two set screws and the Allen wrench are omitted.
cadquery:
part = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(10).extrude(-6)
part = part.cut(cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(1.5).extrude(-6))
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 6, 0)).pushPoints([(5, 5), (-5, 5), (-5, -5), (5, -5)]).circle(1.5).extrude(4)
part = part.cut(holes)
setscrew = cq.Workplane('XY', origin=(0, 3, 0)).circle(1.5).extrude(10)
part = part.cut(setscrew)
